metadata.documentTitle: Peat Decomposition Rates in Intact and Oil Palm Peatlands by Water Table Level
metadata.summary: This document reviews scientific evidence comparing peat decomposition rates and carbon losses between intact peat swamp forests and oil palm plantations, highlighting the correlation between water table depth and CO2 emissions in Indonesia and Malaysia.
